title: SpecKiwi v2.1.0 Target Registration and Active Target Defaulting Plan

phases.title: Core Target Lifecycle and Default Resolution
phases.goal: Implement shared core behavior for target creation and Active Target defaulting.

tasks.title: Extend setActiveTarget create-mode core contract
signatures: interface SetActiveTargetInput { target: string; create?: boolean; targetType?: string; description?: string; dryRun?: boolean }
function renderTargetRow(row: TargetEntry, status?: string): string
implementation_steps: Extend SetActiveTargetInput with create, targetType, and description.
Validate target row cells before rendering.
Retain NOT_FOUND behavior when create is false.
Insert a missing target row only when create is true.
Patch Active Target metadata and active row statuses in one patch plan.
Add a CRLF fixture mutation test that proves the updated index preserves existing line endings.
tasks.rationale: Single core mutation keeps Target Map row creation and Active Target assignment atomic across CLI and MCP.
pitfalls: Do not create a row from a typo unless create is true.
Do not downgrade non-active statuses.
Do not allow pipe or newline in target type or description.
Do not treat pwsh test execution as a replacement for actual CRLF file-content assertions.

rollback.command: 1) Revert only the hunks in src/core/mutation/set-active-target.ts and src/core/types.ts that add create-mode fields and row insertion. 2) Remove the new create-mode assertions from test/core/mutation/set-active-target.test.ts, then run npm test -- test/core/mutation/set-active-target.test.ts.

tasks.title: Resolve omitted addRequirement target from Active Target
signatures: interface AddRequirementInput extends Omit<RenderRequirementInput, "id" | "type" | "target"> { type: RequirementType; scope: string; target?: string; dryRun?: boolean }
function resolveRequirementTarget(workspace: ParsedWorkspace, input: AddRequirementInput): Result<{ target: string; targetSource: "explicit" | "active-target" }>
implementation_steps: Make target optional on AddRequirementInput.
Resolve target after parseWorkspace and before table-cell validation.
Build a resolved input object with target filled.
Preserve explicit target precedence.
Add targetSource to AddRequirementOutput.
Add a CRLF scope-file insertion test for omitted-target requirement creation.
tasks.rationale: Core-level defaulting prevents CLI and MCP divergence.
pitfalls: Do not pass undefined target into renderRequirementBlock.
Do not allow Active Target fallback to bypass Target Map registration.
Do not call table-cell validation before target is resolved.
Do not assume index newline preservation covers scope SRS newline preservation.

rollback.command: 1) Restore AddRequirementInput target to required and remove targetSource from output typing. 2) Delete omitted-target tests and rerun npm test -- test/core/mutation/add-requirement.test.ts.

phases.title: CLI and MCP Surface
phases.goal: Expose core semantics through CLI and MCP without drift.

tasks.title: Add CLI create/defaulting options and tests
implementation_steps: Add create, type, and description options to set-active-target.
Make add-requirement target optional.
Pass optional target only when provided.
Assert JSON output exposes targetSource.
Assert CLI custom target type and description are written to Target Map.
Record any README command-shape delta for TASK-P3-002 rather than editing README in this task.
tasks.rationale: CLI is the fallback interface for agents when MCP is unavailable.
pitfalls: Avoid naming target type option version because the root CLI already has version behavior.
Keep explicit target examples valid.
Keep exit code 5 for mutation denial.
Do not rely on core tests alone for Commander option mapping.

rollback.command: 1) Restore previous Commander option declarations in src/cli/commands/mutations.ts. 2) Remove new CLI assertions from test/cli/mutation-commands.test.ts, then run npm test -- test/cli/mutation-commands.test.ts.

tasks.title: Add MCP create/defaulting tools and schemas
signatures: set_active_target({ target, create?, targetType?, description?, dryRun? })
add_requirement({ type, scope, target?, title, requirement, acceptanceCriteria, ... })
implementation_steps: Pass create, targetType, and description to setActiveTarget.
Omit target from addInput when MCP input target is absent.
Update toolSchemas for create fields and optional add_requirement.target.
Add adapter tests for create, custom targetType and description pass-through, rejection, defaulting, and empty Active Target failure.
Add stdio schema assertions for create, targetType, description, and optional add_requirement.target.
tasks.rationale: MCP client discovery must show the same contract as CLI docs.
pitfalls: Do not use String(input.target) for optional target.
Keep requirement required in stdio schema.
Do not introduce root switching through tool input.
Do not let targetType exist only in core without appearing in MCP schema tests.

rollback.command: 1) Restore previous MCP adapter and schema input handling in src/mcp/tools/mutation-tools.ts and src/mcp/server.ts. 2) Remove new MCP assertions, then run npm test -- test/mcp/mutation-tools-errors.test.ts and npm test -- test/mcp/stdio-purity.test.ts.

phases.title: Agent Workflow, Docs, and SRS Finalization
phases.goal: Document next-target workflow and close SRS evidence after implementation.

tasks.title: Update managed agent instructions for next-target workflow
implementation_steps: Bump managed instruction version from 1.2 to 1.3.
Add next-target authoring workflow text.
Update root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md managed blocks.
Update tests that assert the managed block version and text.
tasks.rationale: Agents need prompt-level guidance to use target creation and defaulting consistently.
pitfalls: Do not remove current work status workflow.
Do not remove Stability guidance.
Keep the suffix marker.

rollback.command: 1) Restore AGENT_INSTRUCTION_VERSION and managed block text in src/core/bootstrap/templates.ts plus root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. 2) Restore test expectations to the previous managed block version, then run npm test -- test/core/bootstrap/init-project.test.ts.

tasks.title: Update docs, SRS evidence, and final gates
signatures: N/A — documentation and SRS status update
implementation_steps: Update README CLI and MCP references.
Compare appendix command/tool fields against implementation and edit only mismatches.
Update SRS requirement evidence after tests pass, preferring SpecKiwi check-ac, add-evidence, and update-status commands or matching MCP tools.
Set requirement statuses to verified only after evidence exists.
Update 00.index.md summaries and Completed Work Log.
Run final gates.
tasks.rationale: The source-of-truth SRS must close the loop after implementation.
pitfalls: Do not add evidence rows for commands that were not run.
Do not mark requirements verified before evidence exists.
Do not use Product Version as the next-target value.

rollback.command: 1) Restore README and docs/spec changes for v2.1.0 evidence/status to their previous planned state. 2) Re-run node bin/speckiwi validate --fail-on-warning --json to confirm the restored SRS is internally consistent.
